title: Zentist Adds Customizable AI Posting Rules
html:
By News Staff

November 24, 2026

Share

Zentist announced a new feature that lets dental practices and groups define, review, and change the rules its Remit AI agents use to post insurance payments into practice management systems.

The feature, called Autoposting Skills, allows organizations to create instructions for handling payments, adjustments, and exceptions. Rules can be based on factors such as denial categories, procedure codes, payers, and Claim Adjustment Reason Codes, according to a press release from the company.

Autoposting Skills can apply across an organization or to selected practices, allowing group dental practices to operate with office-level posting policies. Zentist said billing teams can also trace applied Skills through autoposting history and claim views to see which rule guided a posting decision.

The company said payment-posting decisions may vary by payer, plan, procedure, and office policy, and that the relevant rules often reside in internal documents or in billing teams’ experience. Autoposting Skills are intended to permit dental practices to automate adherence to those rule by creating customized instructions for Remit AI agents to follow.

“Dental groups told us they wanted to understand why a payment was posted a certain way and change the rules themselves when their policies changed,” said Ato Kasymov, CEO of Zentist.

Autoposting Skills is available to Remit AI autoposting customers and to dental organizations considering the platform, Zentist said.
